items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: He used to play this boy that plays mostly in Texas there. What's his, Dominick's nephew? Albert. Don Albert.

ctx.x: He used to play this boy that plays mostly in Texas there. What's his, Dominick's nephew? Albert. Don Albert. Don Albert. Don Albert, yeah. I saw him in the picture. The end of the band there, Frank. Yeah, we were raised together. That's the same as Frank Paisley. The same.
Yeah, well you know Richard M. Jones calls him Brother Red on the record.
